newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Office Products to buy stationers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Office Products to buy stationers.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co said Thursday it has reached preliminary agreement to buy two of the largest contract stationers in the Australian market through its wholly-owned Blue Star Group unit.

The two profitable companies - the Melbourne-based AUSDOC Office Division of publicly-traded AUSDOC Group Ltd and Sydney-based Paperwealth Ltd - have annualized sales of about US$126 million (A$160 million) and will position U.S. Office Products as the second largest contract stationer in the Australian market, a statement from U.S. Office Products said.
U.S. Office Products said total consideration paid for the two companies will be about US$49.8 million (A$63 million) and will be paid in cash.
